title: 稳定身份与生命周期驱动的系统图整合
summary: 系统整合不以文件是否共址定义，而以稳定身份、所有权、依赖、生命周期、资源关系、发现与可追溯性定义。
principles: Physical path is an implementation attribute, not system identity.
Semantic objects and executable runtimes SHOULD be connected by explicit stable identities.
Scarce/shared resources SHOULD be represented as relations rather than hidden assumptions.
The graph SHOULD expose structural inconsistencies such as missing runtime, model, binding, reference, or unreadable registry.
Generation/output revisions SHOULD include runtime/configuration identity when it can change behavior.
